newsitem.title: EU: EP INSTITUTIONAL AFFAIRS COMMITTEE AGENDA - FEB 3-4.
newsitem.headline: EP INSTITUTIONAL AFFAIRS COMMITTEE AGENDA - FEB 3-4.

text.p: Committee on Institutional Affairs [[ Monday 03 February 1997 ]] 0.1 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE220.726 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 18 and 19 December 1996 (PE220.723 ) - 13 January 1997 (PE220.722 ) - 16 January 1997 (PE220.724 ) - 20 and 21 January 1997 (PE220.726 ) 3. Chairman's announcements ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 4. Exchange of views with Mrs Guigou, Parliament's representative at the IGC, on developments at the Intergovernmental Conference ([1] ) 5. Exchange of views with Mr J.J. Kasel, personal representative of Luxembourg at the IGC, on developments at the Intergovernmental Conference ([2]) 6. Motion for a resolution on progress at the IGC (March part-session), with a view to the Conclave in Rome on 25 March 1997 - Exchange of views 7. Relations between the European Parliament and the national parliaments (T04634) INI0485 INI0485 + INST Fond R NEYTS-UYTTEBROECK An (ELD) (PE218.746 ) - Exchange of views 8. Institutional nature of the European Union (T04617) INI0473 INI0473 + INST Fond BERTHU Georges. (EDN) - Exchange of views 9. Exchange of views with Mr Schwaiger (IGC monitor) on majority voting, unanimity, weighting of votes and legislative procedures [3] (PE219.522+ANN ) 10. Exchange of views with Mr Dell'Alba (IGC monitor) on the institutions, subsidiarity and flexibility [3] (PE219.960 ) 11. Development of a security and defence policy (T03967) INI0369 INI0369 + INST Avis A MANZELLA Andrea. (PSE) F POLI Fond R TINDEMANS Leo C. (PPE) - Exchange of views 12. Union rights (T03543) INI0298 INI0298 + INST Avis A SCHAFER Axel. (PSE) F ASOC Fond R OOMEN-RUIJTEN M.G.H. (PE220.024 ) (PPE) - Exchange of views 13.1 Members responsible for monitoring the IGC - 1. Citizenship, fundamental rights, uniform electoral procedure: AGLIETTA/Green Group (PE218.748 ) - 2. Social dimension, employment and the environmental dimension: BARROS MOURA/PSE (PE220.149+ANN) - 3. CFSP and common defence: SPAAK/ELDR (PE219.955 ) - 4. Openness, transparency, simplification and codification: BONDE/I-EDN - 5. Institutions, subsidiarity, flexibility: DELL'ALBA/ARE [see Item 10] (PE219.960 ) 13.2 Members responsible for monitoring the IGC (continued) - 6.1 Third pillar: CEDERSCHIOLD/PPE (PE219.958+ANN) - 6.2 Majority voting, unanimity, weighting of votes and legislative procedures: SCHWAIGER/PPE [see Item 9] (PE219.522+ANN) - 7. Financing, budget, fraud: MARRA/UPE (PE219.961 ) - 8. Role of the Committee of the Regions and economic cohesion: GUTIERREZ DIAZ/GUE 14. Any other business 15. Date of next meeting (in Brussels): (PE/XVI/OJ/97-05 ) 15.1 15.2
[FOOTNOTES]1.) Monday 3 February at 3 p.m. 2.) Monday 3 February at 4.30 p.m. 3.) Tuesday 4 February at 9 a.m. END OF DOCUMENT.
